name: a heron wearing an apron
description: A grey heron stands here in a stained work apron, folded up to nearly your height, moving about its business with the unhurried care of somebody who has done this shift a thousand times.
looks: The apron is tied properly, in a bow, at the back. Somebody with hands did that, and it was not this.
It watches you along the beak, entirely level, and does not blink for a length of time you decide not to measure.
Everything it does, it does in one movement and then stops completely, which is somehow the least human part.
says: Two minutes. Everyone gets two minutes.
I have been on since six. It does not get easier.
Stand where you like. Not there.
emotes: {it} folds its neck down, picks something invisible off the floor, and straightens.
{it} shifts its weight from one leg to the other and settles, apron swinging.
{it} wipes its hands on the apron. It does not have hands.
{it} turns its head all the way round to the door, holds it, and turns back.
asks: How long have you been standing there?
Do you know what time we close?
